source.methods: PointedDripstoneBlock.fallOn; LivingEntity.calculateFallDamage/calculateFallPower; SlimeBlock.fallOn/updateEntityMovementAfterFallOn; HayBlock.fallOn (javap verified 2026-10-06); BedBlock.fallOn (distance*0.5, then Block.fallOn multiplier 1)/bounceUp (vy=-vy*0.66, living); HoneyBlock.fallOn (causeFallDamage 0.2f); PowderSnowBlock.fallOn (sound only, no damage; collision FALLING_COLLISION_SHAPE when fallDistance>2.5); SlimeBlock.fallOn (0f, nothing when suppressing bounce); Entity.checkFallDamage (no accumulation in water), Entity.move (clip FALLDAMAGE_RESETTING/WATER resets), Entity.makeStuckInBlock (reset), LivingEntity.handleOnClimbable (reset) (javap verified 2026-10-06 s6)

bedRule.note: native prismarine physics has no bed bounce: planners must not use beds as landings until it is modelled

techniques.fallDamageResettingClip: Entity.move: when fallDistance != 0 and the collided move has lengthSqr >= 1, a ray from the feet along the move (min(length, 8)) with ClipContext.Block.FALLDAMAGE_RESETTING (#fall_damage_resetting as a full cube) and Fluid.WATER resets fallDistance; Entity.checkFallDamage then adds only this tick's dy (terminal <= 3.92): landing through a ladder/vine/scaffolding/cobweb/water cell is harmless. Slower moves rely on LivingEntity.handleOnClimbable (reset) or Entity.makeStuckInBlock (cobweb, powder snow).
techniques.ladderOnWall: implemented: clutch.ladderPlan — a ladder clicked on a visible full side face of a wall into one of the three cells above the landing while the body is still above that cell (BlockItem.canPlace: the thin plate may not intersect the body)
techniques.boat: riding resets the fall every tick (LivingEntity.rideTick -> resetFallDistance); AbstractBoat.checkFallDamage accumulates/clears only the boat's own distance and deals no damage. Landing ON a boat entity is a normal landing on the block under it (Entity.checkFallDamage -> Block.fallOn, full damage). A boat clutch must place the boat and mount it before contact; not implemented.
techniques.enderPearl: ThrownEnderpearl.onHit: teleport, ServerPlayer.resetFallDistance, then hurtServer 5.0 (fall damage type). Not a landing technique in the reflex (pearls are reserved).
techniques.windCharge: Player.causeFallDamage: with currentImpulseImpactPos and ignoreFallDamageFromCurrentImpulse the fall is measured from the impulse impact height (min with fallDistance); landing at or above that height takes none. Not implemented.
techniques.lava: Entity.baseTick halves fallDistance each tick in lava (not a rescue).
techniques.order: clutch reflex: natural water -> bucket (not the Nether) -> ladder on a wall (ladder in hotbar) -> block chain on visible faces -> soft floor steer (ND_SOFT_LANDING=1) -> none
